Preserve both active domains; no automatic duplicate public ticks from private Log, no old-user data deletion.
domain.venues: public.venues: id UUID, user_id UUID owner, name text, kind crag|gym|board, area nullable text, description nullable text, image_url nullable text, is_public boolean, created_at/updated_at timestamptz. RLS: visible public/owner/moderator, write owner. Discovery includes existing public boards without inventing real-world crags or seed data in production.
domain.routes: Extend existing routes, not a second route catalog: venue_id nullable UUID, discipline enum existing native values (default board for existing board routes), grade_system native enum, grade_label nullable/backfill only known grade_v/grade_font, height_m nullable positive, rock_type nullable text, terrain nullable slab|vertical|overhang|roof. Existing board grade_v/grade_font and editor graph remain active domain attributes; keep their consumers. wall_id may be null for outdoor routes (no fake wall IDs). Existing route image/holds remain canonical. New UI creation must supply real facts or null; no hardcoded limestone/height/location for production.
domain.attempt_link_cutover: Rename climb_attempts.board_route_id to route_id and migrate every active SQL/client/test consumer. Route link can now target board or outdoor routes; nullable for manually named climbs. No legacy field alias. Keep existing discipline/grade/outcome/notes/session semantics and privacy.
domain.follows: public.follows(follower_id UUID, following_id UUID, created_at timestamptz), composite PK, no self-follow; public relationships/counts, authenticated caller may insert/delete only own follower_id. Use existing shared Follow type names where correct; no duplicate aliases.
domain.bookmarks: public.route_bookmarks(user_id UUID,route_id UUID,created_at timestamptz),composite PK; strictly owner-only read/write and only accessible routes may be saved. Hidden/deleted route targets must not leak facts through saved/Feed APIs.
domain.activity: public.activity_events(id UUID,recipient_id UUID,actor_id UUID,kind like|comment|follow|crew_send,post_id nullable UUID,created_at timestamptz,read_at nullable timestamptz). Create from actual like/comment/follow/new followed-author post transitions; no self-notifications. Recipient-only read/mark-read; no client event forging or changing actor/recipient/kind. Constraints/indexes deduplicate transitions; removal behavior tied to real source. Actor public identity joins. Inbox is community notifications, not private attempt history.
domain.visibility: Every discovery/feed/activity join must preserve current private session boundaries and underlying route/wall/venue visibility. Only explicitly published session fields may cross authors. Never fabricate Following status from a profile name, expose private notes/timelines, or use service-role clients.
domain.models: Data owner adds canonical shared TS types matching current Swift models and CommunityRoute/CommunityVenue/CommunityClimber/ActivityEvent; web imports them, native owns Codable counterparts. Explicit nullable metadata; unavailable fields omitted honestly in UI. Port canonical native grade ranking/statistics into existing shared utilities, with meaningful edge tests only.
domain.private_session_context: Add nullable conditions text(1..500) and notes text(1..1000) to climbing_sessions and both client models/forms. Private by existing session ownership; never implicitly publish notes/conditions through Feed. Share caption is a separate deliberate publication field.

workflow.authoring: Only allowlisted files inside own explicitly assigned worktree. Primary, siblings and run records read-only. Main alone integrates reviewed exact artifacts. No push, remote changes, migrations on existing DB, package installs, broad tests, format/lint or cleanup. Skip ALL build/test/render validation during concurrent authoring; report ready for Main risk-selected verification. Blender asset export is required deliverable generation, not validation.
workflow.structural: Any divergence from this interface pauses affected work: STRUCTURAL_CHANGE packet=<id> head=<sha-or-WIP> interface=<identifier> impact=<breaking|schema|signature|dispatch> action=<required-action>; all affected owners ACK. Do not negotiate incompatible APIs ad hoc.
workflow.handoff: Commit only packet-owned files locally; return base/head/changed paths, actual implementation coverage, exact runnable verification scenarios, risks. Do not self-approve; V1Designer and independent reviewer/vision gate integration. Main will supply reviewed dependency commits/rebase when needed, never worker merge.
